steps.name: single-BLE-card-route-and-canonical-visual-on-phone-large
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'RELEVANT_PHONE_LARGE_E2E'
LCL_E2E_PORT=5291 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --grep='installed automation dashboard shows Shelly runtime on phone-large' --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-saved-card-181-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-saved-card-181-e2e.err || {
 echo 'E2E_FAILED'
 tail -25 /tmp/shelly-ionic-saved-card-181-e2e.err
 python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-saved-card-181-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):]);print('STATS',j.get('stats'))
except Exception as e:print('PARSE_ERROR',str(e),s[-1400:])
PY
 exit 60
}
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-saved-card-181-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
stats=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):])['stats']
print('PHONE_LARGE_E2E_STATS',stats)
assert stats['expected']==1 and stats['unexpected']==0 and stats['flaky']==0 and stats['skipped']==0
PY
echo 'NO_SNAPSHOT_UPDATES'
echo 'WORKTREE';git status --short
uptime
